steps.clue: Ring the four tower gongs, defeat their champions and place their heads on the spikes.
Obtain the Death of Orion and combine bone meal, burnt wood and dung to create fertilizer.
Get Fire Bomb kills on the fertilizer and destroy the red pods throughout Danu Tower.
Ignite the four bull symbols with the Brazen Bull and defeat the summoned champions.
Read the Ra Obelisk and kill the special enemies in the displayed order.
Raise the four metal rods, charge them with Kill-O-Watt and survive the Arena challenge.
Shoot the three symbol sets with Serket’s Kiss and survive the lockdown in The Pit.
Enter the Arena portal and defeat the waves of Gladiators and Tigers.
Defeat Fury and Wrath, the two war elephants.
